reason: B presents a more physically grounded and testable mechanism linking quantified local chemical order to a rugged dislocation-energy landscape, strength, and slip behavior, with direct supporting evidence in NiCoCr/CrCoNi and a single-phase constraint that limits precipitation confounding. A relies on a less defensible universal coupling between lattice distortion and ordering, imposes an arbitrary five-element criterion, and proposes diffraction methods that may not adequately resolve chemical short-range order.
